params.note: exogenous parameters (paper Table 5 style); exact delta_param=5e-3 flip not measured on GPU — A8/A9 verdicts bracketed by the 3e-3/1e-2 grid; C1 checked via Hellinger proxy in output space (units differ from state-norm gamma); AT-3 margins npz broken (margins_of indexed vals[:,0] of a (B,S,2) tensor -> shape (1,2)) — regularity cond 3/6 derived at the last layer from intact logits dumps (K=128 common positions); cross-model state similarity reported as top canonical correlation cca_rho on the leading R_PCA=32 principal directions of last-layer hidden states (paired linear least-squares 'Procrustes' is under-determined when hidden dim > S=512 positions and returns D~0 for any two models — first-run values ~3e-6 were that artifact, not a result; cca_rho~0.9 across all model pairs reflects shared low-frequency positional trend of per-position states in the dominant PCA directions, i.e. common sequential structure rather than fine-grained architectural similarity)
